#KRT 5- KRT17+
```{r}

data = lung %>% FetchData(vars = c("KRT5","KRT17"))  %>% mutate(KRT5_state = ifelse(KRT5>0,"high","low"),
                                                KRT17_state = ifelse(KRT17>0,"high","low")) 

lung = AddMetaData(object = lung,metadata = data[,c("KRT5_state","KRT17_state"),drop=F])
lung$KRT_quadrant <- paste0("KRT5_", lung$KRT5_state, "/KRT17_", lung$KRT17_state)
table(lung$KRT_quadrant)
DimPlot(lung, group.by = "KRT_quadrant", cols = c(
  "KRT5_low/KRT17_low"   = "lightgrey", 
  "KRT5_high/KRT17_low"  = "#ff0000", # אדום
  "KRT5_low/KRT17_high"  = "#00ff00", # ירוק (מה שחיפשת)
  "KRT5_high/KRT17_high" = "#ffcc00"  # צהוב/כתום
)) + ggtitle("KRT5/KRT17 Co-expression States")
```

```{r fig.height=5, fig.width=9}
plot_data <- lung@meta.data %>%
  group_by(time.point, KRT_quadrant) %>% 
  summarise(count = n()) %>%
  mutate(percentage = count / sum(count) * 100)


ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = time.point, y = percentage, fill = KRT_quadrant)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "stack") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "KRT5_low/KRT17_low"   = "lightgrey", 
    "KRT5_high/KRT17_low"  = "#ff0000", # אדום
    "KRT5_low/KRT17_high"  = "#00ff00", # ירוק
    "KRT5_high/KRT17_high" = "#ffcc00"  # צהוב
  )) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(y = "Percentage of Cells (%)", x = "Time Point", fill = "KRT Status") +
  ggtitle("Distribution of KRT5/KRT17 Subsets over Time")
```
```{r fig.height=8, fig.width=6}
#per model
plot_data <- lung@meta.data %>%
  group_by(time.point, patient.ident, KRT_quadrant) %>% 
  summarise(count = n()) %>%
  mutate(percentage = count / sum(count) * 100)


ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = time.point, y = percentage, fill = KRT_quadrant)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "stack") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "KRT5_low/KRT17_low"   = "lightgrey", 
    "KRT5_high/KRT17_low"  = "#ff0000", # אדום
    "KRT5_low/KRT17_high"  = "#00ff00", # ירוק
    "KRT5_high/KRT17_high" = "#ffcc00"  # צהוב
  )) +
  facet_grid(patient.ident ~ .) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(y = "Percentage of Cells (%)", x = "Time Point", fill = "KRT Status") +
  ggtitle("Distribution of KRT5/KRT17 Subsets over Time")
```
